QUOTE: `app/routes/(authenticated)/thread.tsx` also passes `hasSearch={false}`, but it is not in the caller list, so I did not count it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer excludes the thread route and states that `Header` from `header.tsx` is a separate component that only uses `hasSearch` to hide the title. It does not count either one as a renderer of NavigationHeader. It never mentions the navigation hook, but the thread route and `Header` exclusions carry the item.
